rationale: The workflow already caches its primary dependency installation: setup-node is configured with cache: npm and cache-dependency-path pointing at main_service/frontend/package-lock.json. There is no pip install / uv sync step in this release workflow (the version-validation step imports only Python stdlib tomllib/ast/os/pathlib, and uv build / uv publish only build metadata and upload the wheel rather than installing runtime dependencies), so adding a ~/.cache/pip dependency cache would be a no-op unrelated change. The remaining candidate patterns are not supported for this workflow: P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT requires representative successful-duration history, but ci_history reports no completed runs; P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE is contraindicated because this is release/deployment work; P-LIT-SKIP-WORKFLOW is contraindicated because a release/publish contract requires the trigger to execute and no omission policy is established; P-LIT-FAIL-FAST has no matrix. No evidence-supported, coverage-preserving optimization applies.
